description: Yuyuko activates her "Ability to Manipulate Death," officially beginning the battle. Soul-hunting checks and attribute updates become frequent, with values continuously changing.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: [Hard-to-Find Devouring Luo Xueyu]'s 'Soul Hunt' check: Roll: 1D20+8d4=3+{2+2+2+4+2+3+1+3}(19)=22 Challenge: 10 Success Success Level: 3

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The Sunshi's rampage happened in an instant. Tempted by the漫天 Spring Energy, this creature completely lost control. It let out a greedy hiss, its massive body twisting towards the Saigyou Ayakashi. Its maw, lined with sharp teeth, opened even wider, as if to devour the entire demon tree along with the ghost princess seated upon it. The shadow it cast dimmed even the light of the Netherworld. "I'm sorry!" Xueyu's apology was as light as a sigh, torn apart by her actions. Under the cover of the chaotic shadow created by the Sunshi, she moved. The heavy Saw Cleaver dragged along the ground, scraping against the dark jade tiles and erupting in a screeching noise and a trail of bloody sparks, as if the blade itself was weeping blood from desire. Her figure blurred amidst the giant shadow and overflowing streams of Spring Energy, closing in like a ghost beside Yuyuko, who was still focused on the Sunshi. No battle cry, only the resolve to pour all her strength into a single point. The Saw Cleaver swung upwards from below, its heavy body tearing through the air. That ominous bloody light was dragged into a crimson meteor, carrying a sharpness that seemed capable of severing cause and effect, aiming with precision and ferocity towards Yuyuko's elegant neck in a diagonal slash! Where the blade passed, even the scattered cherry blossom petals were split in two by the residual force.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: In reality, the Sunshi is eating the Spring Energy on the floor, and Xueyu's blade is pressed against her own chest, having already pierced the skin. The pain awakens Xueyu. The Yuyuko in front of her is still delivering a flat, fake cry of pain.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Lina Yuyuko Xueyu Ge Qing Long'er

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I, I promised the Sunshi I could only be eaten by it" #shouting with eyes closed, hugging the Saw Cleaver

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Nothing in this world is flawless; everything has its weakness. Even the world's surface has thin spots. Ge Qing abandoned her eyes, turning herself into a blind compass, all to 'see' those weaknesses with her own eyes. Although Ge Qing still has a long way to go before achieving her great work, at this moment, finding the weakness of the person before her is already enough!

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: [Observer Ge Qing]'s 'Soul Hunt' check: Roll: 1D20+8d4+2d6=10+{3+3+3+4+2+1+2+1}(19)+{4+2}(6)=35 Challenge: 10 Success Success Level: 5

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Ge Qing's cross-legged posture remains motionless in the Netherworld's wind, yet her sleeves flutter without any breeze. The illusory eyes surrounding her blink faster and faster, emitting a dense, unsettling rustling sound, as if countless unseen beings are gazing upon this place through them. The crack between her eyebrows silently widens. No blood flows, only a void deeper than the Netherworld itself. The giant eye that emerges from it has a pupil that is a constantly rotating purple vortex. The moment it gazes at Yuyuko, the flowing Spring Energy, the scattering cherry blossoms, even the Netherworld's own inherent laws seem to transform into threads that can be analyzed. The next moment, she unhesitatingly stabs the sharp staff in her hand into her own chest. No scream, only a muffled grunt. A drop of crimson blood slides down the staff, evaporating into a scarlet mist before even touching the ground. But this act of self-mutilation seems to break some kind of shackle. The violently fluctuating aura around her abruptly returns to deathly stillness. An absolute emptiness replaces everything. She is still there, yet seems to have merged with the Netherworld's darkness, entering a state of forgetting both self and object, where only "weakness" exists. She has abandoned sight, abandoned distracting thoughts, even abandoned perception of self. At this moment, she has become a weapon that exists solely to pierce through. The purple light from the giant eye between her brows suddenly becomes intensely dazzling, firmly locking onto the single "point" it has found. An inexplicable aura emanates from Ge Qing's body (next martial technique base 15).

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Long'er's hand traces through the void, drawing an ∞ symbol, linking UUZ's and Ge Qing's bodies together. By connecting the space-time and reality between the two, she continuously adjusts the direction of Ge Qing's upcoming attack and amplifies her power.

conversation.speaker: player6

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The aura emanating from Ge Qing grows stronger and stronger, reaching its peak with the appearance of the infinite.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: A girl's voice echoes in your hearts. Stand closer together. The voice, though girlish, feels unnervingly mature, exuding a sense of calculated, effortless scheming.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Pulls everyone to Ge Qing's side with Messiah Fist

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: In Ge Qing's mind's eye, it's the aura of that strange woman she observed before. Behind, Yukari Yakumo slowly opens a gap and extends her arms, embracing you all.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: A wave of warmth surges in your hearts. The previous injuries and lost spiritual power are partially restored.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Immediately after, as the strange woman behind releases her hold and retreats into that space filled with eyes, a thin film adheres to your skin on its own. It's colorless and imperceptible, clinging to each of your skins. You've been enhanced, go for it!

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Yuyuko's ability has been somewhat restricted. Ara? Who is Yukari Yakumo? Suspicious woman plays dumb.

I think they're called彼岸花, right?" Lina's body, surrounded by the crimson Spring Energy, seems to have grown a little, that handheld microphone has also grown into a person-height standing microphone "This way, the voice can reach every seed too, right?"
